title: Zero-Trust Formal Methods: AI Agents Build Verified Checkers for Untrusted Solvers
abstract: arXiv:2611.28704v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI coding agents now generate code faster than humans can review it. Security analyses rely on solver answers such as "unsatisfiable" (for example, no attack path exists) or "optimal." Unlike satisfying models, they cannot be checked by looking at them. Formal verification moves trust from code to specifications, but verifiers still place large SAT, SMT, and answer-set solvers, and the translation into solver queries, in their trusted computing base, and these have had soundness bugs. Unlike agent-based pipelines that trust their verifier and solver, our farm trusts no component by default: neither the AI agents, which might make mistakes or game their objectives, nor the solvers. A solver answer counts only if a verified checker accepts its certificate. Every theory, proof, and line of code is generated by AI. For each component, agents first create an Isabelle/HOL theory with a specification, a soundness proof, and a reference checker

translated_title: 零信任形式化方法：AI智能体为不可信求解器构建经验证的检查器
translated_abstract: AI编程智能体如今生成代码的速度已超过人类审查的速度。安全分析依赖于求解器的答案，例如“不可满足”（即不存在攻击路径）或“最优”。与满足模型不同，这些答案无法通过直接查看来检查。形式化验证将信任从代码转移到了规约上，但验证器仍然将大型SAT、SMT和答案集求解器以及向求解器查询的转换过程置于其可信计算基之中，而这些组件曾出现过可靠性漏洞。与信任其验证器和求解器的基于智能体的流水线不同，我们的农场默认不信任任何组件：既不信任可能犯错或为达成目标而投机取巧的AI智能体，也不信任求解器。只有当经验证的检查器接受其证书时，求解器的答案才算有效。每一个理论、每一份证明、每一行代码都由AI生成。对于每个组件，智能体首先创建一个包含规约、可靠性证明和参考检查器的Isabelle/HOL理论。
tldr: 该论文提出零信任形式化方法，让AI智能体自动生成Isabelle/HOL理论、可靠性证明和经过形式验证的检查器，使得求解器的答案只有在验证检查器接受其证书后才被采信，从而完全不信任AI智能体和求解器本身。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a zero-trust formal methods approach where AI agents automatically generate Isabelle/HOL theories, soundness proofs, and verified checkers, so that solver answers are accepted only when a verified checker validates their certificates—trusting neither the AI agents nor the solvers themselves.
